theorems.name: Submission.p06_9e0f5043ff_pae_place_equivalence_degree
theorems.statement: ∀ (K E L : Type*) [Field K] [Field E] [Field L] [Algebra K E] [Algebra K L] (e : E ≃ₐ[K] L), ∃ θ : AlgebraicCurve.Place K E ≃ AlgebraicCurve.Place K L, (∀ v : AlgebraicCurve.Place K E, (θ v).deg = v.deg) ∧ (∀ v : AlgebraicCurve.Place K E, ∃ r : v.toValuationSubring ≃ₐ[K] (θ v).toValuationSubring, ∀ a : v.toValuationSubring, (r a : L) = e (a : E))
theorems.natural_summary: Pull each valuation subring back along e.symm. Restricting e gives the required compatible algebra isomorphism and transfers principality; containment of K and properness are preserved. Transport along e.symm supplies the inverse on places, using Place.ext. The induced residue-field algebra isomorphism preserves finrank, hence degree, without finiteness assumptions.
